instruction: Go to the FlightAware discussions section and check the latest activity feed for recent posts.

metadata.explanation: Task variation asking user to navigate to FlightAware discussions and view the latest activity feed. Uses existing is_expected_active_tab metric to verify the /latest URL is opened. Similar complexity to original - requires finding and navigating to a specific section of the forum.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator logic correctly verifies the instruction requirements. The instruction asks to navigate to FlightAware discussions and view the latest activity feed.

Getter 'active_url_from_accessTree' with goto_prefix 'https://' correctly reads the active tab URL from Chrome's address bar without triggering a page reload. When user navigates to discussions.flightaware.com/latest, getter will return 'https://discussions.flightaware.com/latest'.
Metric 'is_expected_active_tab' correctly compares the result URL with expected URL 'https://discussions.flightaware.com/latest' using URL comparison logic.
Expected URL 'https://discussions.flightaware.com/latest' is semantically correct - this is the actual URL for FlightAware discussions latest activity feed.
Complete coverage: The evaluator verifies exactly what the instruction requires - that the user navigated to the correct URL to view the latest activity feed.
No postconfig needed: The getter reads URL state directly from accessibility tree without page reload, which is appropriate for verifying navigation completion.
validation.fix_description: Changed result.type from 'active_tab_info' to 'active_url_from_accessTree' to avoid page reload and correctly verify user's navigation state.
